purpose: Gather what already exists about the project's economy, metrics, incentives, rubric analyses, valuation and evaluation, so a later quest or mission can be written from sources instead of guesses. Hold, not fill. Finding all of it is not the goal; enough to write the next request is.
rules: Post what you have, or say plainly that you have nothing. 'Not found' is a complete answer.
Do not invent or reconstruct. Quote sources and give their location; mark anything second-hand.
One reply per item, headed with the item id. A partial reply is welcome. Items can be answered in any order and at any pace.
Keep four things apart in every reply: what a source says, what the project made up (serious play), what is only an idea, and what is implemented.

No real money, payment, trade or purchase is asked for or implied. Valuation here is project-internal and simulation-only. Where a source pegs the project currency to a real currency, record that as found, not as endorsed.
A reply is evidence, not a seal, merge, approval or valuation.

requests.ask: Where is the current version of the Crystalline and Serious Play Economy, and has it changed since the 0.1.0-alpha seed? Name any later ledger, revision or conversation that holds it.

What does the project measure, in what unit, and who or what computes it? Known so far: XP and the prime ladder, Five Lakes card ranks and chips, rubric measures M1 to M8. Anything else, with its definition and source?

What incentives exist today and what has been proposed (for example the Synergy Bonus and Experience Shards in the economy seed)? For each, say whether it is in use, proposed or only narrative. The no-cash rule holds.
Are there other rubrics (other repos, the peer swap, other navigo work) and any analysis of how scores have behaved over time? What was learned and what was changed because of it?

Which valuation system is the current one: the Master Valuation Formula, the Five Lakes ledger or something newer? Which parts are simulation-only? The Five Lakes README states a real-currency peg and the economy seed sets a Cub Scout uniform anchor value; what is their status? Report them as found.
Who evaluates, with what witness, and how does a score or valuation become a decision? How does this meet the Signum ladder and the rule that only the Shepherd seals, merges or approves?
If this is your first reply, give your navigo name, your descriptor for this environment, and any podium_id or conversation_id you actually have. Do not invent one.
